title: 2.4 Sum and Difference Formulas

icans: I can use sum and difference formulas to find exact values.
I can use sum and difference formulas to rewrite and evaluate expressions.
I can use sum and difference formulas to solve equations.

vocab: sin(u ± v) = ______________;  cos(u ± v) = cos u cos v ∓ sin u sin v;  tan(u ± v) = (tan u ± tan v)/(1 ∓ tan u tan v)

blocks.p: Use a calculator in degree mode. Round to three decimal places.
Does cos(u + v) = cos u + cos v? __________   Which expression matched cos(30° + 60°)? ______________________________
